overview.label: Overview
overview.title: Urban Geometry
overview.description: A shared 3D representation of the London corridor, providing spatial context for urban simulation and scenario exploration.
overview.note: Shared city geometry for the London corridor.

whiteCity.label: White City campus
whiteCity.title: White City Campus Geometry
whiteCity.description: A detailed campus scene connecting landmark buildings, surrounding urban geometry and indoor environments.
whiteCity.note: Campus buildings share the city coordinate system.

interior.label: I-HUB Interior
interior.title: LiteReality-Agent
interior.description: An authored concept office inside the White City I-HUB building, connected to the surrounding city through an outdoor-to-indoor camera journey.
interior.note: Concept office layout, not a measured reconstruction. Related project: LiteReality-Agent.

londonTube.label: London Tube
londonTube.title: Underground Network and Station Geometry
londonTube.description: Explore London's underground network and 53 representative station environments, with timetable-based train movement in the network view.
londonTube.note: 53 representative station environments. Interior sections and depths include assumptions; train movement is timetable-based.

traffic.label: Traffic
traffic.title: SUMO Microscopic Traffic Simulation
traffic.description: Recorded vehicle trajectories and signal states from a SUMO simulation, using an OSM-derived road network and synthetic traffic demand.
traffic.note: Recorded SUMO trajectories and signal states; road controls and traffic demand are illustrative.

uavs.label: UAVs
uavs.title: WavePDE
uavs.description: Wave-equation-based UAV route planning through urban geometry.
uavs.note: Precomputed routes for 100 synthetic stations. Fleet scheduling and collision avoidance are not part of this replay.

wind.label: Wind
wind.title: SCALED
wind.description: A scalable generative model for computational physics, used to generate urban wind fields conditioned on building geometry.
wind.note: 100 recorded speed-magnitude samples on a 16 m display grid.

temp.label: Temperature
temp.title: GPU-based PyTorch Temperature Solver
temp.description: A GPU-based PyTorch solver for temperature transport through wind advection, diffusion and surface heat exchange.
temp.note: 11 recorded frames on a 32 m grid, at 8 m height.

solar.label: Sunlight
solar.title: GPU-based PyTorch Solar Solver
solar.description: A GPU-based PyTorch solver for clear-sky solar irradiance and building shadows throughout the day.
solar.note: 100 samples for 21 June on an 8 m grid. Clear-sky conditions; playback starts in daylight.

poll.label: Pollution
poll.title: GPU-based PyTorch Pollution Solver
poll.description: A GPU-based PyTorch solver for traffic-emission transport and dispersion through urban wind fields.
poll.note: 100 frames on an 8 m grid. Conditional exhaust PMx increment, not observed total PM2.5. Some source mass is excluded in this partial-source preview.

flood.label: Flooding
flood.title: LISFLOOD-FP · Xuan et al., 2026
flood.description: Surface-water depth during a three-hour rainfall scenario, simulated with LISFLOOD-FP.
flood.note: 100 recorded frames over three hours on an 8 m pooled display grid. The linked paper describes related methodology, not this London experiment.

cosmosVideo.label: Cosmos3-Super: Video generation
cosmosVideo.title: Generative Scene Rendering
cosmosVideo.description: Cosmos3-Super transforms Canopy-derived visual inputs into illustrative rendered videos.
cosmosVideo.note: Pre-generated illustrative video, not a quantitative physics result.

cosmosText.label: Cosmos3-Super: Text modification
cosmosText.title: Language-Guided Scene Editing
cosmosText.description: Natural-language instructions are translated into validated scene-editing code to modify building geometry and appearance.
cosmosText.note: Recorded code edits and undo. Geometry changes do not recompute physics.
